selection: All 13 remaining untouched entries at positions20: in the original remaining_adequate order; no replacement or outcome selection

gates.end_to_end_definition: Grade accepted AND normal successful CLI/terminal event AND full frozen rule body output; provider errors and timeouts count as failures in the full planned denominator
gates.known_v6_development_regression_gate: The separately registered environment-revalidation-2026-10-27-v2 d09-d12 window passed its original12/12 gate after the six-session long diagnostic; bind its exact reports, checkers, original raw evidence archive, unchanged candidate, CLI, model/provider/authentication and proxy/MXC policy. Original12+1 failures, the stopped proxy-only window and the prior11/12 MXC window remain unchanged and failed. Known readiness is not fresh/generalization or comparative-efficiency evidence.

review_method: Original task, base and candidate source only, neutral names; no skill, intended answer, reference repair, hidden grader, parent grades/costs or previous conclusions. Fixed r0 artifacts cannot be replaced after failures.
execution_policy: No repeated model attempts to replace failures. Retain failed launches, API errors, timeouts, incomplete usage and grade-only recovery histories; no missing usage imputation. Do not change model/provider to work around capacity. Actual exhausted quota stops queued calls; no purchases, authentication copying or quota resets.
transport_change: Before any fresh calls, bind the existing credential-free loopback OS proxy plus all HTTP(S)/ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY variants into native CLI child environment. Select windows.sandbox=mxc for this process, keeping workspace-write and never approvals. MXC compatibility and workspace-write/outside-write-denial probes plus a native shell/read/write/Python canary must pass. The controller does not edit saved settings, ACLs, provider, model, authentication or TLS. The prior legacy elevated sandbox attempted its own provisioning and failed; this automatic setup is disclosed, not described as absence of host-side effects. Freeze the helper, exact complete route/bypass policy, successful canaries, stopped prior window and separate known-contract readiness. These environment corrections do not erase earlier failures or demonstrate skill efficiency.
incomplete_record_policy: A nonzero CLI/API failure without a thread may count only as a negative end-to-end outcome. Missing record/grade is described from actual frozen-plan failure/started/done evidence, never synthesized into successful records. Not-attempted work is explicit. Any incomplete attempt records make the overall evidence-integrity verdict false until checkpoint-only recovery resolves them; no model replacement and no qualification based only on surviving rows.

It treats incomplete sessions as failures within the same >=95% task threshold, rather than separately requiring100% operational completion. v5 remains failed and is never reevaluated under this criterion. Its confirmed regressions are known development cases, not fresh samples.
